task_instance: Assemble an evidence-linked regression report from a saved campaign: build a realistic one-change campaign (frozen scope.json, registry.json, and sealed+accepted prepare/hunt/reproduce/replay/adjudicate stage records that confirm one REPRODUCED_REGRESSION finding), then run the skill's report.py over the campaign directory to render HTML, Markdown and JSON reports.
evidence: The skill bundles scripts/report.py (plus evidence.py, registry.py, runtime.py) and requires Python >=3.13 with no third-party deps; python3 3.13.17 and uv 0.11.32 are present. Copied the four scripts into <work>/scripts/. Wrote <work>/build_campaign.py to produce the INPUT a user supplies before the report stage: using the plugin's own registry/evidence helpers (initialize, reserve, bind with isolated host launch records, candidate, seal, accept) it created <work>/campaign/ with scope.json, registry.json, runtime/ launch receipts, and five sealed+accepted stage records (attempts/a001..a005) for change P1, confirming candidate h001-001 with distinct agent handles for reproduce/replay/adjudicate (run logs are synthetic placeholders; no model or live experiment is run, which the skill's report stage does not require). Ran the deliverable: 'PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/report.py <work>/campaign --output reports' exited 0 and printed campaign/reports/index.html. Verified the three rendered outputs in campaign/reports/: report.md and report.json show counts REPRODUCED_REGRESSION=1 (others 0), coverage P1=COMPLETE, and finding h001-001 outcome=REPRODUCED_REGRESSION verification=isolated category=FUNCTIONAL_BUG severity=Medium likelihood=Medium with rating reasons and evidence links; index.html contains one <section>, the 'REPRODUCED_REGRESSION (isolated)' label, and the injected candidate title's angle brackets are HTML-escaped (no raw <script>). Also verified the refusal path: editing a sealed artifact after sealing made report.py exit 1 ('Report integrity error: Stale or changed evidence ...; no report written') and write no report directory. The skill's documented launcher 'uv run --no-project' was blocked by the runtime's external-code auto-deny; report.py was run directly with python3 instead, which is equivalent since the bundled script is the deliverable and has no external dependencies. Files produced: <work>/campaign/ (full campaign), <work>/campaign/reports/{index.html,report.md,report.json}, <work>/build_campaign.py, <work>/scripts/{evidence,registry,report,runtime}.py.
